landing.heroTitle: Never Miss a Dose. Always Stay Connected.
landing.heroSubtitle: A calm, shared healthcare ecosystem bringing elders, caretakers, family members, and doctors together on one simple schedule.
landing.builtForElders: Specially designed for Indian elders with Hindi, Marathi & English support, large fonts, and voice reminders.
landing.elderCardDesc: Big buttons, clear Hindi/Marathi labels, time-of-day slots, and audio playback. No complex menus.
landing.doctorCardDesc: Full prescription control, AI daily summaries, risk detection, and audit histories in a clinical ledger.
landing.caretakerCardDesc: Mark doses given, log clinical observations, and receive stock refill warnings.
landing.familyCardDesc: Instant alerts only when a dose is missed or taken late. Peace of mind from anywhere in the world.

elder.allDosesComplete: All doses completed for today. Well done!
elder.revokeConfirm: Are you sure you want to revoke access for {name}?

doctor.verifyBeforeSave: AI Draft — Verify dosages and frequency before approving.

pwa.installDesc: Add Smriti to your phone's home screen for quick daily access like a regular app.
pwa.iosInstructions: To install on iPhone: tap the Share button below, then select 'Add to Home Screen'.

errors.UNAUTHORIZED: Session expired or invalid. Please log in again.
errors.INVALID_CREDENTIALS: The email, phone, or password you entered is incorrect.
errors.FORBIDDEN: You do not have permission to perform this action.
errors.NOT_FOUND: The requested record was not found.
errors.CONFLICT: This email or phone number is already registered.
errors.VALIDATION_ERROR: Please check the entered information and correct any errors.
errors.INVITE_INVALID: This invite passcode is invalid or has been revoked.
errors.INVITE_EXPIRED: This invite passcode has expired (valid for 48 hours). Please request a new one.
errors.INVITE_ALREADY_USED: This invite passcode has already been used.
errors.TOO_MANY_ATTEMPTS: Too many attempts. Please wait 15 minutes before trying again.
errors.DOSE_WINDOW_CLOSED: This dose cannot be marked at this time (outside the allowed schedule window).
errors.DOSE_NOT_MARKABLE: This dose has already been recorded or is not pending.
errors.UNDO_WINDOW_EXPIRED: The 10-minute undo period for this dose has expired.
errors.AI_RATE_LIMITED: AI hourly limit reached (max 20 per hour). Please try again later.
errors.AI_UNAVAILABLE: Clinical AI service is momentarily busy. Algorithmic fallback has been applied.
errors.USER_DEACTIVATED: Your account has been deactivated. Please contact support.
errors.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR: An unexpected error occurred. Please try again shortly.
